ext.description: VSCode extension for CodeWiki — ontology-based code analysis, health checks, and an MCP server for precise AI code understanding.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with CodeWiki
walkthrough.description: Initialize, check code health, and use the one-click panel.
walkthrough.step.init.desc: Detect the CLI, write MCP config, and index your project.
walkthrough.step.health.desc: Open the tabbed Health / Security / Patterns panel.
walkthrough.step.usage.desc: One-click access to every CodeWiki feature.
config.language: UI language for CodeWiki panels (Usage / Health).
config.llmProvider: LLM provider for wiki generation and code analysis.
config.apiKey: API key for the selected LLM provider.
config.cliPath: Command used to run the CodeWiki CLI. Use a runner + repo script ('npx tsx', 'ts-node'), or a globally installed binary name ('codewiki').
config.autoIndex: Automatically index the workspace when the extension activates.
config.codeLens: Show CodeWiki code lenses above classes/functions.
